contractRules: CaseId/subcase identity is stable data and is separate from semantic callable names.
Every current callable, including same-signature callbacks in distinct owners and nested lambdas, has one source-qualified owner/declaration mapping row.
Observe_*, SurfaceNNN, and _Nominal names are hard-renamed without source aliases; required runtime/reflection/FName names carry an explicit reason.
Expected*/bExpect* parameters are absent from proposals; expected values live only in typed contract vectors and runner assertions.
Raw returns and explicit &out/&inout writebacks replace compound comparison masks; blocking rows must be resolved before source editing.
Each callable receives an adjacent English knowledge comment covering role, fixture/owner, phase, inputs, raw output/writeback/side effect, boundary, and cleanup.
Lifecycle, timer, delegate, RepNotify, Blueprint, component, and actor claims require real runner dispatch and explicit cleanup; direct callback calls are defects.
DefaultComponent null pseudo-success is replaced by non-null exact identity/class/owner/Outer/world/registration/attachment observations.
This audit records design status only and never invents compile, execution, or PASS status.
